kl.definition: KLu(B||Q): KL over the union of B's and Q's top-20 next-token sets plus one tail bucket, per a_Q token, teacher-forced on the identical prompt ids (score_driver.py); truncated, not the full KL

candidates.KLu_0: KLu at the first a_Q token

kl.tie_break: same as the frozen rule: + 1e-9 * int(sha256('token-trigger-v1|' + state_key)[:8], 16) / 16**8
